t: 教宗西尔维斯特一世被尊为圣人,为后期教宗密尔蒂亚德的接班人.
te: Pope Sylvester I is consecrated, as successor to the late Pope Miltiades.
dz: 教宗西尔维斯特一世被尊为圣人,为后期教宗密尔蒂亚德的接班人.
de: Pope Sylvester I is consecrated, as successor to the late Pope Miltiades.

t: 阿列斯的第一个综合体由阿列斯主教马里努斯开放.
te: The first synod of Arles is opened by bishop Marinus of Arles.
dz: 阿列斯的第一个综合体由阿列斯主教马里努斯开放.
de: The first synod of Arles is opened by bishop Marinus of Arles.
